notes: 48 ABI functions plus the fallback reviewed. Same OZ Governor family as c00487 (propose, hashProposal, castVote*, quorum, state reviewed by structure; same decompiled shapes). Differences from c00487: the executor is the timelock, so onlyGovernance's popFront loop and _beforeExecute's pushBack loop are live and both present. Loops: 4 explicit in the bytecode, all whiles: Checkpoints._upperBinaryLookup (17 inlined copies), Governor._beforeExecute (execute), _isValidDescriptionForProposer (propose, 'while True' with the bound test first), onlyGovernance's popFront loop (7 copies, rotated: P3). Strings.toHexString is not in this bytecode (no hex alphabet) and TimelockController.scheduleBatch runs in the timelock: not counted. Implicit: 10 validating decodes, 31 encode copies (P7), the new string[](n) init (rotated, counted in P3). DoubleEndedQueue checks the pre-5.0 'end <= begin' empty test with Empty(): matches the bundled OZ version. No semantic error found.
summary: Faithful, all 4 loops present, but the governance queue loop is printed rotated with its pop peeled, the timelock calls of execute/queue lose names and arguments after an allocation, and proposal encoding is a set of copy loops.
